connector.name: GenflowAI
connector.registryDescription: Run GenflowAI templates and AI creative workflows for ecommerce visuals, UGC ads, and videos.
connector.summary: Hosted at genflowai.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cwjgege account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Use Bearer <GENFLOWAI_API_KEY> for private saved workflows, asset uploads, template/workflow runs, and async result polling. Public template discovery works without this header.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Optional GenflowAI API key alternative for clients that do not support Authorization bearer headers.
